name: native-base
rules: Write semantic HTML. button, input, select, textarea, dialog, details, table, progress and meter are styled with no classes.
Composite components use one data attribute as their hook: data-card, data-badge, data-alert, data-avatar, data-tabs, data-carousel, data-toast, data-tooltip, data-breadcrumb.
Variants on any component: data-variant="secondary|outline|ghost|link|destructive|success|warning". Sizes: data-size="sm|lg|icon".
Open overlays with invoker commands, not JS: <button commandfor="id" command="show-modal|close|toggle-popover|show-popover">, or popovertarget="id".
Layout: data-row (wrapping flex, =between|end|center), data-stack (vertical), data-grid (responsive columns). Tune with style="--gap:…" or "--min:…".
Theme with shadcn/ui CSS variables (--primary, --background, --radius, …). Everything lives in @layer nb.*, so unlayered CSS always wins.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: Theme variables (shadcn/ui names), automatic light/dark with light-dark(), and the shared variant vocabulary.

api.[name=color-scheme]: Any select or radio group with this name switches the page theme, no JS
api.data-variant: secondary | outline | ghost | link | destructive | success | warning

items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: A small reset plus typography for headings, paragraphs, lists, code, kbd, mark and focus rings.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout
items.description: Three layout primitives that cover most screens: row, stack and grid.

api.data-row: Wrapping flex row. Values: between | end | center

items.name: transitions
items.title: Page transitions
items.description: Cross-document view transitions for every same-origin navigation. Crossfade by default, slide on request.

api.html[data-transition]: slide | none. Also pins body > header in place
api.view-transition-name: Set on any element to morph it between pages

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Plain <button> elements. Variants and sizes are data attributes; links become buttons with data-variant.

api.<a data-variant>: A link styled as a button
api.data-group: Wrap buttons or inputs to join their edges

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text inputs, textarea, file and range. Labels wrap fields, and validation messages appear without JS.

api.<label>Text <input></label>: Label wraps the field, no for/id needed
api.<small data-hint>: Shown until the field is invalid
api.<small data-error>: Shown only after the user makes the field invalid

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox & Radio
items.description: Custom-drawn checkboxes and radios that keep native semantics, keyboard support and form participation.

api.<input type=radio>: Group with a shared name inside <fieldset>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A checkbox that looks like a switch.

api.<input type=checkbox role=switch>: Switch in every browser (Safari also accepts the switch attribute)

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The native select, upgraded to a fully styleable picker where appearance: base-select is supported.

api.<select>: Works everywhere, styled picker where supported
api.<button><selectedcontent></selectedconte: Optional: mirror rich option HTML into the closed select

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress & Meter
items.description: Determinate, indeterminate and threshold-colored bars from <progress> and <meter>.

api.<meter value low high optimum>: Colors itself green, amber or red

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with optional header and footer slots.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status labels.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callouts for important messages, with an optional icon.

api.data-alert: Container. Children: optional svg, strong, p
api.role=\"alert\": Add when the message appears dynamically

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round image or initials, with overlapping groups.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Readable data tables straight from <table> markup.

api.<table>: thead, tbody, tfoot and caption are styled
api.data-numeric: Right-aligned tabular numbers on th or td

items.name: loading
items.title: Skeleton & Spinner
items.description: Placeholders and busy states.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are in the site hierarchy.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog & Sheet
items.description: Modal dialogs and edge sheets on <dialog>. Opened with invoker commands, animated in and out with CSS.

api.command=close: Closes it. As the dialog's first child it becomes the corner ✕
api.closedby=\"any\": Close on backdrop click and Esc
api.data-side: left | right | bottom turns it into a sheet

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Light-dismiss floating panels anchored to their trigger with CSS anchor positioning. No ids in CSS, no JS.

api.<div popover id>: The panel, positioned under its trigger

items.name: menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A <menu> popover of buttons and links.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: One-attribute tooltips drawn with attr(). For richer content use popover=hint.

api.data-tooltip=\"text\": Shows on hover and keyboard focus (not on void elements like input)

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A corner notification built from <output popover>.

api.<output popover data-toast id>: The toast, announced by screen readers
api.command=show-popover: Show it from a button, or call showPopover()

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Animated <details>. Share a name to allow only one open at a time.

api.name=\"group\": Exclusive: opening one closes the others

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Exclusive <details> laid out as tabs. Falls back to an accordion.

api.<details name open><summary>: One tab, all sharing a name

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Scroll-snap slides with CSS-generated prev/next buttons and dots.

api.--slide: Slide width, e.g. 50% to show two
